title: "GHG Inventory Project Hub"
toc: false

This repository is the coordination hub for the U.S. Greenhouse Gas Inventory (GHGI) pipeline. It holds the schema registry, methodology narratives, cross-cutting rules, and project conventions that every source-category repository depends on. It does not pull, transform, or calculate emissions data; that work happens in the source-category repositories.

The documentation follows the [Diátaxis](https://diataxis.fr/) framework, which sorts each document by what the reader needs at that moment.

## How-to guides

Task-focused steps for someone who already knows what they want to do.

- [Render the documents](how-to/render-the-documents.qmd)
- [Query the schema](how-to/query-the-schema.qmd)

## Reference

Facts to look up while working: rules, definitions, and specifications.

- [Cross-sector boundary rules](reference/cross-sector-boundaries.qmd): which sector reports each emission
- [Methodology reference](reference/methodology/ghg-inventory-methodology.qmd): calculation methodology and coding annotations by source category
- [Example methodology narrative: wastewater](reference/methodology/sample-smn-wastewater.qmd)
- [Glossary](reference/glossary.qmd)

Learning-oriented lessons for newcomers. None yet; a natural first tutorial would walk a new contributor through one source category from narrative to validated output.
